home.tagline: World state, fissures, traders, and rotations — a handy Warframe board
home.searchHint: Market / Riven / Help / Subscribe live on their own pages; jump chips scroll the board.

tools.title: Tools
tools.lead: More standalone tools are on the roadmap.
tools.body: This Tools page is still planned (drop tables, todos, etc.). Use the Home modules for world state and market queries.

about.title: About Lanius
about.lead: Lanius-Warframe-Bot: official/community data through a custom API for QQ and the public site.
about.archBody: Clients only call the Lanius API — never Warframe upstream directly. QQ and Web stay decoupled at runtime.
about.scopeBody: MVP is international only. No player accounts, trade matching, or full wiki mirrors.
about.qqBody: Tencent official QQ bot only. Push subscriptions are managed in QQ.

fissures.title: Void Fissures
fissures.intro: Current international fissure list from worldstate. Filter by relic era, mission type, and Normal / Steel Path / Empyrean.

market.title: Market
market.intro: Fuzzy-lock one item, then list online/ingame sell orders (price↑, 10 per page).

riven.title: Riven
riven.intro: Fuzzy-lock one weapon, then list online/ingame riven auctions (price↑, 10 per page).
riven.emptyHint: Enter a weapon name to search.

rotations.title: Weapon rotations
rotations.intro: Tenet (Ergo Glast) and Coda (Eleanor) current shelves: all weapons shown equally with icons, bilingual names, element glyphs, and a Valence bar (scaled to 60% max). Percentages are manually maintained.

subscribe.title: Subscriptions
subscribe.intro: Push subscriptions are managed in QQ. This page explains usage only — Web does not bind QQ openids.
subscribe.qqBody: Send root commands to the bot (leading / optional):
subscribe.webNote: Admins can view/toggle subscriptions at /admin; the public site is read-only.

help.title: Command help
help.qqHint: Each QQ command is its own root (e.g. /worldstate, /help). A leading / is optional. Reply mode and card skin are set in the admin console.

admin.title: Admin
admin.placeholder: After login: config, releases, modules, subscriptions, rotations, ACL, and help menu.
